# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Island  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a blonde young woman. She was described as radiant in her silk clothing when visiting Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Honora possesses a grave and serious outlook on life compared to some of her peers. She has a sense of humor, enjoys laughing with her close friends, and can react giggly to funny situations.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P23](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0023), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)_

## Traits

- Serious-minded  <sub>[v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>
- Friendly  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>

## Abilities

- Greek language studies  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>

## History

Honora traveled to Wexcombe alongside Nell Harcourt to pursue her higher education. Upon their arrival at Wexcombe, she and Nell met Cressida Lindsay, who introduced them to her wide network of social connections and campus circles. While attending classes, she engaged in academic studies alongside Nell and Mabel Colby. During one visit to Grey Shutters, Honora brought her aunt, the noted author Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley, and Mrs. Pendexter to meet Nell.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)_
